repos.name: Ledger
repos.description: How people spend, and how to catch a card thief. A year of card payments at Meridian Bank, explained in plain words. Built with Python and SQL.
repos.source: 8ad6151eb85d3f3b2a156a1d98aaea6fde18e276|How people spend, and how to catch a card thief. A year of card payments at Meridian Bank, explained in plain words. Built with Python and SQL.|data-analysis,data-visualization,fraud-detection,pandas,portfolio,pytest,python,sql,sqlite,window-functions
repos.summary: A data analysis project that uses a synthetic dataset of 430,000 card payments to visualize spending patterns and detect fraudulent transactions.
highlights: Implements six automated fraud checks using SQL window functions to identify card testing, copied cards, and hijacked accounts.
Features an MCP server that allows AI assistants to query the database and explain transaction block decisions.
Includes a scoring system that evaluates the precision and recall of different fraud detection thresholds.
Automated testing with pytest ensures fraud rules trigger correctly on malicious patterns without false positives.

repos.name: DiogoS7.github.io
repos.summary: An interactive personal CV website that visualizes career milestones through a solar-system-themed canvas animation.
highlights: Features an 'Ask my CV' terminal powered by Cloudflare Workers AI to answer questions about professional experience.
Uses a GitHub Action to automatically generate AI-written repository cards via README analysis.
Includes skill-based project filtering and a responsive design with light and dark themes.
Built without frameworks or build steps using vanilla web technologies.
